snippet.title: TheRusted - OfficialTrailer
snippet.description:
RODD Games proudly presents

THE RUSTED

We are finally ready to share the first look at this atmospheric 2D action-puzzle platformer  — a quiet journey through a world where machines no longer protect what they once loved.
Humanity is gone.
But one robotic dog still remembers its family.

Coming Soon to Steam
